title: Membuat alert baru dari simulasi anomali

Click the action to start an anomaly simulation
Follow the elderly confirmation flow until it completes
Verify a new alert is visible in the notifications state
Verify the home dashboard reflects the updated alert status

title: Simulate an anomaly and confirm it from the elderly view
description: This verifies that a simulated anomaly can be confirmed from the elderly confirmation screen and creates a new alert in the family app.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the anomaly simulation from the home dashboard
Confirm the event from the elderly confirmation screen
Verify a new alert is displayed in notifications
Verify the alert is marked as new

Open the Pengaturan tab
Select "Sensor langsung (lewat HP Pusat)"
Open the Beranda tab and wait up to 10 seconds
Verify the chip "Sensor langsung" is displayed
Verify the "Sensor gerak" card title is either "Belum ada gerakan terdeteksi" or "Gerakan terdeteksi di area pemantauan" and is NOT "Penghubung sensor tidak terjangkau"

Verify no "Rekaman uji" chip is displayed

title: Mengubah sumber data ke sensor langsung dan melihat pembacaan live

Click the settings tab
Choose the direct sensor data source
Return to the home dashboard
Verify live sensor readings are displayed
Verify technical connection details are visible

title: Switch to live sensor mode and return to the home dashboard

Open the settings tab
Select the live sensor data source
Return to the home dashboard
Verify the live sensor chip is displayed
Verify the sensor status card is displayed

title: Alert darurat terbuka dapat dilihat detail dan ditindaklanjuti

steps.description: Navigate to /
Trigger an emergency alert from the demo flow
Open the alert detail or follow-up view
Mark the alert as checked or completed
Verify the alert detail view is displayed
Verify the alert is marked as handled

title: Melihat ringkasan beranda demo
description: Pengguna melihat ringkasan status harian di Beranda dalam mode demo dan memahami kondisi pemantauan saat ini.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the home dashboard is displayed
Verify the daily status summary is visible

title: View daily status on the home dashboard
description: This verifies that the home dashboard shows the current daily status summary and priority status card in demo mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the home dashboard is displayed
Verify the current daily status summary is displayed

title: Pengguna memeriksa detail alert dan menandainya selesai dari Notifikasi
description: Operator dapat membuka alert penting dari daftar Notifikasi, melihat detailnya, lalu menandai alert sebagai sudah dicek atau selesai.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Notifikasi tab
Open an alert that needs attention
Mark the alert as checked or completed
Verify the alert detail is displayed
Verify the alert status changes to handled

title: Konfirmasi butuh bantuan menambahkan alert darurat
description: Pengguna dapat menyelesaikan simulasi anomali dengan respons butuh bantuan dan melihat alert darurat baru tercatat di app keluarga.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button to simulate an anomaly
Choose that the elder needs help
Return to the family app
Verify the dashboard is shown again
Verify a new emergency alert is recorded

title: Membuka detail alert terbaru dari notifikasi
description: Pengguna membuka Notifikasi, memilih alert paling baru di bagian perlu ditanggapi, dan melihat detail level, status, waktu, serta isi alert.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the notifications tab
Click the most recent alert in the action-needed section
Verify the alert detail screen is displayed
Verify the alert level, status, time, and detected event details are visible

title: Open alert details and mark an alert as checked
description: This verifies that an operator can open an alert from notifications, review the details, and mark it as already checked.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the notifications tab
Open an alert that requires attention
Mark the alert as already checked
Verify the alert is no longer in the open state
Verify the alert detail remains accessible

title: Melihat ringkasan dashboard demo saat pertama dibuka
description: Pengguna melihat status harian utama, metrik ringkas, dan aktivitas terakhir pada Beranda dalam mode demo.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the chip "Demo · data contoh" is displayed under the profile
Verify the status card title is "Sedang dicek keluarga" with a "Darurat" badge and "Hari ini, 09.12" (it must NOT say "Normal")
Verify the text "Diperbarui 24 September 2026, 09.20" is displayed above the metric cards

title: Menandai alert waspada sebagai sudah dicek lalu selesai
description: Pengguna menindaklanjuti alert Waspada baru dari Notifikasi dengan menandainya sudah dicek lalu selesai, dan melihat respons tercatat.

steps.description: Navigate to /
On the Beranda, in the dashed "Fitur demo" section, click the button that simulates a changed pattern ("Simulasi pola berubah") to create a new Waspada alert
Click the notifications tab
Open a new warning-level alert
Mark the alert as checked
Mark the alert as finished
Verify a recorded response is visible
Verify the alert shows as resolved

title: Contact family from an urgent alert
description: This verifies that an operator can open an urgent alert and use the family contact follow-up action from the alert detail.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the notifications tab
Open an urgent alert
Start the family contact follow-up action
Verify a call follow-up modal is displayed
Verify the alert remains visible behind the follow-up flow

title: Simulasi anomali menampilkan layar konfirmasi lansia
description: Pengguna dapat memulai simulasi anomali dari Beranda dan melihat layar konfirmasi lansia dengan penghitung waktu dan pilihan respons.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button to simulate an anomaly
Verify the elder confirmation screen is displayed
Verify the countdown and response options are displayed

title: Menghubungi kontak keluarga dari alert darurat
description: Pengguna membuka detail alert Darurat, memulai panggilan ke keluarga, mengakhiri panggilan, dan melihat respons tercatat kembali di detail alert.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the notifications tab
Open an emergency-level alert
Start the family contact call
End the call
Verify a call response is recorded
Verify the alert detail remains available after the call

title: Inspect live sensor technical details
description: This verifies that the live sensor mode exposes technical device information, including the serial port and data source.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the settings tab
Select the live sensor data source
Return to the home dashboard
Expand the technical details section
Verify "Port" shows "COM23"
Verify "Sumber" shows "Perangkat (serial)"
Verify "Kekuatan sinyal (RSSI)" shows a value in dBm

title: Menghubungi keluarga dari alert darurat membuka modal panggilan simulasi
description: Pengguna dapat memulai tindakan panggilan dari alert darurat dan menutup modal untuk kembali ke status tindak lanjut yang benar.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Trigger an emergency alert from the demo flow
Click the button to contact the family member
Close the simulated call modal
Verify the call modal was shown
Verify the alert remains in a follow-up state

title: Konfirmasi baik-baik saja menambahkan alert info
description: Pengguna dapat menyelesaikan simulasi anomali dengan respons baik-baik saja dan melihat kembali ke app keluarga dengan alert info tercatat.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button to simulate an anomaly
Choose that the elder is doing well
Return to the family app
Verify the dashboard is shown again
Verify an informational alert is recorded

title: Pengguna membuka detail alert dan memilih langkah hubungi keluarga
description: Operator dapat menindaklanjuti alert dari Notifikasi dengan opsi menghubungi keluarga dan melihat bahwa status tindak lanjut diperbarui.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Notifikasi tab
Open an emergency alert
Choose to contact the family member
Verify the alert detail is displayed
Verify the follow-up state is shown

title: Reorder family contacts and pause monitoring in demo mode
description: This verifies that changing contact priority and enabling monitoring pause in settings updates the home dashboard state in demo mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the settings tab
Move one family contact higher in priority
Enable monitoring pause
Return to the home dashboard
Verify the monitoring paused state is displayed
Verify the updated contact priority is reflected in settings

title: Meninjau riwayat tujuh hari dan berpindah metrik
description: Pengguna masuk ke Riwayat, berpindah antar tab metrik, memilih hari tertentu, dan melihat detail perbandingan pola biasanya.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the history tab
Switch to the sleep duration metric tab
Switch to the activity time metric tab
Switch to the night awakenings metric tab
Select the day with an unusual marker
Verify the seven-day history view is displayed
Verify the selected day detail shows a comparison against usual patterns

title: Riwayat menampilkan metrik harian dan perbandingan saat tanggal dipilih
description: Pengguna dapat membuka Riwayat, berpindah tab metrik, memilih hari tertentu, dan melihat pola hari itu dibandingkan biasanya.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Riwayat tab
Switch between the sleep duration, active time, and night wake-ups metrics
Select a specific day in the history view
Verify the selected day's history data is displayed
Verify a comparison against the usual pattern is displayed

title: Browse seven-day history by metric and day
description: This verifies that the user can open the seven-day history view, switch between metric tabs, and inspect a selected day’s pattern comparison.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the history tab
Select a sleep duration metric tab
Select a different day in the seven-day history
Verify history data for the selected day is displayed
Verify a pattern comparison is displayed

title: Beralih ke setiap tab utama dari navigasi bawah
description: Pengguna dapat berpindah antar layar utama aplikasi keluarga melalui navigasi bawah dan melihat layar yang sesuai.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the tab for Riwayat
Click the tab for Notifikasi
Click the tab for Pengaturan
Verify the Pengaturan screen is displayed
Verify the bottom navigation remains available

title: Kedaluwarsa konfirmasi lansia otomatis menghubungi keluarga
description: Pengguna melihat bahwa jika tidak ada respons pada layar konfirmasi lansia hingga waktu habis, sistem menandai keluarga sedang dihubungi dan mencatat alert darurat.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the button to simulate an anomaly
Wait for the confirmation timer to expire
Return to the family app
Verify the family-contacting state is shown
Verify a new emergency alert is recorded

title: Melihat batasan mode sensor langsung pada Riwayat dan Notifikasi
description: Pengguna mengaktifkan mode sensor langsung lalu membuka Riwayat dan Notifikasi untuk memastikan fitur yang tidak tersedia menampilkan state batasan yang sesuai.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the settings tab
Choose the direct sensor data source
Open the history tab
Open the notifications tab
Verify the unavailable history state is displayed
Verify the unavailable notifications state is displayed

title: See history and notifications unavailable in live sensor mode
description: This verifies that history and notifications are disabled with an explanation when the app is set to live sensor mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the settings tab
Select the live sensor data source
Open the history tab
Verify a live sensor mode unavailable message is displayed
Open the notifications tab
Verify a live sensor mode unavailable message is displayed

title: Badge notifikasi muncul setelah alert baru dibuat di mode demo
description: Pengguna melihat jumlah notifikasi bertambah saat alert baru belum ditangani di mode demo.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Create a new unanswered alert from the demo flow
Open the Notifikasi tab
Verify a notification badge is displayed
Verify the new alert appears in the notifications list

title: Menjeda pemantauan pada mode demo dan melihat dampaknya
description: Pengguna mengaktifkan jeda pemantauan di mode demo dari Pengaturan dan melihat bahwa status Beranda berubah sesuai kondisi dijeda.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the settings tab
Pause monitoring in demo mode
Return to the home dashboard
Verify the paused monitoring state is displayed
Verify the home dashboard no longer shows an active monitoring state

title: Menjeda dan melanjutkan pemantauan di mode demo mengubah status beranda
description: Pengguna dapat menjeda pemantauan di mode demo dan melihat perubahan status di Beranda, lalu melanjutkannya kembali.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Pengaturan tab
Pause monitoring in demo mode
Return to the Beranda tab
Verify the paused monitoring state is displayed on the dashboard
Verify the dashboard no longer shows the paused state after monitoring is resumed

title: Reset demo data to the initial state
description: This verifies that resetting demo data restores the app to the initial demo story and home dashboard state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the settings tab
Trigger the demo data reset
Return to the home dashboard
Verify the home dashboard shows the initial demo state
Verify prior demo changes are no longer present

title: Mode sensor langsung menonaktifkan riwayat dan notifikasi yang tidak berlaku
description: Pengguna melihat batasan mode sensor langsung saat membuka Riwayat dan Notifikasi sehingga layar yang tidak relevan menampilkan state kosong atau nonaktif.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Pengaturan tab
Select the live sensor data source
Open the Riwayat tab
Open the Notifikasi tab
Verify the history screen shows a disabled or empty state
Verify the notifications screen shows a disabled or empty state

title: Mengatur ulang prioritas kontak keluarga
description: Pengguna membuka Pengaturan, mengubah urutan kontak keluarga, dan melihat susunan prioritas yang baru tersimpan di layar.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the settings tab
Reorder the family contact priorities
Verify the updated contact order is visible
Verify the settings screen reflects the new priority order

title: Mengatur prioritas kontak keluarga memperbarui urutan tampilannya
description: Pengguna dapat mengubah urutan kontak keluarga di Pengaturan dan melihat urutan baru tersimpan di layar yang sama.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Pengaturan tab
Reorder the family contacts
Verify the contacts appear in the updated order

title: Mereset data demo ke kondisi awal
description: Pengguna menggunakan reset data demo dari Pengaturan dan melihat aplikasi kembali ke cerita awal mode demo.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the settings tab
Reset the demo data
Return to the home dashboard
Verify the demo data returns to its initial state
Verify the home dashboard reflects the reset demo story

title: Membatalkan konfirmasi panggilan darurat
description: Pengguna membuka dialog konfirmasi panggilan darurat dari detail alert dan membatalkannya tanpa meninggalkan layar detail.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the notifications tab
Open an emergency-level alert
Open the emergency service confirmation dialog
Cancel the confirmation dialog
Verify the emergency confirmation dialog is closed
Verify the alert detail screen remains visible

title: Jeda pemantauan dinonaktifkan di mode sensor langsung
description: Di mode sensor langsung switch jeda tidak bisa dipakai dan tidak boleh tampil dijeda, karena pembacaan sensor tetap berjalan.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the Pengaturan tab
Turn on the "Jeda pemantauan" switch
Verify the text "Pemantauan sedang dijeda" is displayed
Select "Sensor langsung (lewat HP Pusat)"
Verify the "Jeda pemantauan" switch is disabled and not checked
Verify the text "Jeda belum tersedia di mode sensor langsung. Pembacaan sensor tetap berjalan." is displayed
Verify the text "Pemantauan sedang dijeda" is NOT displayed
Select "Demo (data contoh)"
Verify the text "Pemantauan sedang dijeda" is displayed again

title: Beberapa alert aktif: Darurat yang sedang dicek mengungguli Waspada baru
description: Kartu status memilih alert terbuka paling serius dari gabungan Baru dan Sedang dicek.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the status card title is "Sedang dicek keluarga" with a "Darurat" badge
Scroll down and click "Simulasikan pola berubah"
Verify the status card still shows "Sedang dicek keluarga" with a "Darurat" badge (not the new Waspada)
Verify the "Notifikasi" tab shows a badge with 1
Click "Lihat & tindak lanjuti" on the status card, then click "Tandai selesai", then click "Kembali"
Verify the status card now shows "Ada pola yang berubah dari biasanya, perlu dicek" (the Waspada)
Click "Lihat & tindak lanjuti", click "Tandai sudah dicek", click "Tandai selesai", click "Kembali"
Verify the status card shows "Normal" and "Pola keseharian terlihat seperti biasanya"

title: Masuk dengan akun keluarga dan sesi diingat setelah muat ulang
description: Keluarga masuk dengan email dan kata sandi akun demo, lalu tetap masuk setelah halaman dimuat ulang.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the heading "Masuk ke NADI" is displayed and the bottom navigation is NOT displayed
Type "rina@nadi.id" into the "Email" field and "nadi1234" into the "Kata sandi" field
Click the "Masuk" button
Verify the Beranda shows "Status saat ini" and the bottom navigation (Beranda, Riwayat, Notifikasi, Pengaturan) is displayed
Reload the page
Verify the Beranda is still displayed without asking to log in again

title: Login gagal menampilkan pesan yang jelas
description: Field kosong, format email salah, dan kata sandi salah masing-masing menampilkan pesan yang jelas dan pengguna tetap di layar masuk.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the "Masuk" button without filling any field
Verify the messages "Isi email dulu, ya." and "Isi kata sandi dulu, ya." are displayed
Type "rina-nadi" into "Email" and "nadi1234" into "Kata sandi", then click "Masuk"
Verify a message starting with "Format email belum benar" is displayed
Replace "Email" with "rina@nadi.id" and "Kata sandi" with "salah123", then click "Masuk"
Verify the message "Email atau kata sandi belum cocok. Coba periksa lagi." is displayed, the "Kata sandi" field is empty, and the heading "Masuk ke NADI" is still displayed

title: Keluar dari akun lewat Pengaturan
description: Keluarga yang sudah masuk melihat akunnya di Pengaturan, lalu keluar dan kembali ke layar masuk.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Log in with "rina@nadi.id" / "nadi1234"
Click "Pengaturan" in the bottom navigation
Verify the "Akun" section shows "Rina Wahyuni" and "rina@nadi.id"
Click the "Keluar" button
Verify the heading "Masuk ke NADI" and the message "Kamu sudah keluar. Masuk lagi kapan saja." are displayed
Reload the page
Verify the heading "Masuk ke NADI" is still displayed (the session was cleared)

title: Menyiapkan HP Pusat lalu membuka pengaturan dari mode lansia
description: Akun Pusat disiapkan keluarga (perangkat dilewati, kode keluarga, mulai), lalu mode lansia hanya bisa dibuka pengaturannya dengan kata sandi.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Log in with "sri@nadi.id" / "nadi1234"
Verify "Langkah 1 dari 3" and the heading "Sambungkan perangkat" are displayed
Click "Lewati, pakai data demo"
Verify the heading "Kode untuk keluarga" and the code "482 917" are displayed, and "Rina Wahyuni" is listed as already linked
Click "Lanjut", then click "Mulai"
Verify the elder screen shows "Halo Bu Sri" and "NADI sedang menemani di rumah." and there is NO bottom navigation
Focus the "Pengaturan (untuk keluarga)" button with the keyboard and press Enter (or press and hold it for about 1 second)
Type "salah" in the "Kata sandi" field and click "Buka pengaturan"
Verify the message "Kata sandi belum cocok. Coba lagi." is displayed
Type "nadi1234" in the "Kata sandi" field and click "Buka pengaturan"
Verify the heading "Pengaturan HP Pusat" with sections "Perangkat", "Kode keluarga", and "Akun" is displayed
Click "Kembali ke layar orang tua"
Verify "Halo Bu Sri" is displayed again

title: HP Cabang menautkan ke HP Pusat dengan kode keluarga lalu melepas tautan
description: Akun Cabang yang belum tertaut memasukkan kode keluarga; kode salah ditolak dengan pesan jelas, kode benar membuka Beranda; lepas tautan dikonfirmasi dulu.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Log in with "budi@nadi.id" / "nadi1234"
Verify the heading "Tautkan ke HP orang tua" is displayed and there is NO bottom navigation
Click "Tautkan" with the code field empty
Verify the message "Isi kode keluarga dulu, ya." is displayed
Type "111 111" in the "Kode keluarga (6 angka)" field and click "Tautkan"
Verify the message "Kode belum cocok dengan HP Pusat mana pun. Coba periksa lagi." is displayed
Replace the code with "482 917" and click "Tautkan"
Verify the Beranda shows "Tertaut dengan HP Ibu Sri Wahyuni." and the bottom navigation is displayed
Open "Pengaturan" in the bottom navigation
Verify the "Akun" section shows "Tertaut ke HP Pusat" and "HP Ibu Sri Wahyuni"
Click "Lepas tautan"
Verify a confirmation dialog "Lepas tautan dari HP Pusat?" is displayed
Click "Ya, lepas tautan"
Verify the heading "Tautkan ke HP orang tua" is displayed again

title: Jawaban di HP Pusat muncul sebagai alert di HP Cabang (simulasi satu perangkat)
description: Di prototipe, aliran data Pusat ke Cabang disimulasikan pada perangkat yang sama: jawaban "Butuh bantuan" di HP Pusat menjadi alert Darurat di app keluarga.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Log in with "sri@nadi.id" / "nadi1234"; if the setup screen appears click "Lewati, pakai data demo", then "Lanjut", then "Mulai"
In the "Fitur demo" area click "Tampilkan pertanyaan konfirmasi"
Verify the question "Halo Bu Sri, apakah baik-baik saja?" is displayed
Click "Butuh bantuan"
Verify "Keluarga sedang dihubungi." and a "Selesai" button are displayed
Click "Selesai", then open the settings with the "Pengaturan (untuk keluarga)" button (Enter or press and hold) and password "nadi1234"
Click "Keluar dari akun", then log in with "rina@nadi.id" / "nadi1234" (do NOT reload the page)
Verify the Beranda status card shows "Darurat" with a description mentioning "Butuh bantuan", and the "Notifikasi" tab shows 1 pending item
